content.short: Orby Network is a native stablecoin lending protocol on Cronos Chain that enables borrowing USC tokens.
content.description: Orby Network is the first native stablecoin (USC) lending protocol on Cronos Chain, delivering an interest-free borrowing experience for USC while loans remain overcollateralized. With USC, users can invest in the Stability Pool to earn rewards. Orby Network is designed to make lending in DeFi easy, safe, and accessible for a broad range of users, helping newcomers and seasoned participants alike engage with decentralized finance on Cronos.
